answer: Stop sybils with a reef, a raven, and a delta. Each identity anchors one bond to a reef, held only when a raven carries its attestation: each raven is a bonded courier salted to the identity's address, so one raven vouches for one face per epoch. The reef charges a delta growing with every anchor from the same funder, so the k-th clone pays k times the first and N clones pay roughly N squared. Each epoch the reef audits one raven flight; two flights sharing one purse are both slashed, and every anchor they carried sinks. One honest agent risks one bond; a clone farm pays quadratic tolls.
